## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Vessantarapañha* ("Vessantara’s Giving") is a section of the *Milindapañha* (Mil 6.3.1) exploring the ethical and doctrinal issues surrounding the extreme giving of Prince Vessantara [SuttaCentral]. The text has a passage-level parallel cataloged in the *Cariyāpiṭaka* (Cp 9, *Vessantaracariya*) and is directly linked thematically to the *Vessantarajātaka* (Ja 547) [SuttaCentral]. Three modern translations across three languages are indexed on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
In computational text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus, the *Vessantarapañha* shares 445 matching passages across 23 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Within the *Milindapañha* itself, extensive textual overlap occurs with other question sections, notably the *Katādhikārasaphalapañha* (Mil 5.1.1), the *Devadattapabbajjapañha* (Mil 5.1.3), the *Pathavicalanapañha* (Mil 5.1.4), and the *Udakasattajīvapañha* (Mil 6.1.9) [DharmaNexus]. Matches are also observed across commentarial literature, including the *Jātaka-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Pāthikavaggaṭṭhakathā*, and the subcommentary *Milindaṭīkā* [DharmaNexus]. Beyond Pali, DharmaNexus automatically aligns passages of the text with the Tibetan translation of the *Jātakamālā* (D4150) and the Chinese *Ekottarika Āgama* (*Zengyi Ahan jing*, T 125) [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
